QF.id: SIA Logic Model for Social Programs_9

question.text: Per Ch 4.3 of the SIA workbook, which of the following BEST defines 'Impact' within the Logic Model?

answer.text: The immediate deliverables produced by project activities within the financial year
The tasks performed during the t0 year
The budgeted cost of inputs recovered from donors
The enduring consequences — both intended and unintended — of all inputs and activities, which may manifest over several years or after project completion

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 4.3(i), Impacts are enduring consequences (intended and unintended) of all inputs and activities. They may manifest over several years, immediately after project completion, or in the long term depending on the project's gestation period. A clear withdrawal protocol is needed to sustain outcomes and transform them into impact. The Trap: A defines outputs. C defines recovered funding (accounting). B defines t0 pre-project activities. Cross-Exam Context: Impact-vs-outcome discipline is tested across XXIII Ch 5 and SAS standards, and maps to SROI methodology (X-A Investment Adviser, XV Research Analyst on SSE valuation). Assessor's Pro-Tip: Impact takes years. Do not let an SE claim 'impact' in year 1. For year-1 AIRs, scope your opinion to outputs and intermediate outcomes; flag impact claims as 'not yet assessable' rather than signing them off.
